title: Sophie's Choice
author: William Styron
current_text: Sophie's Choice by William Styron was banned in Lebanon for its positive depiction of Jews. In 2002 the Norwalk-La Mirada High School District pulled it from the La Mirada High School Library in California because of a parent's complaint about its sexual content.
